description: PHP script for handling related list display and navigation in the PurchaseOrder module of vtiger CRM, including entity retrieval, session management, and template rendering.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty class used for template rendering in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves entity information for a given record and module.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related lists for the current module and entity.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to the session for display.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves related modules from the session.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific fields.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Gets the sequence number field for a module.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for a record.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks permissions or state for a button.
